find_alchemy_profit.description: The items worth more cast to coins than they cost to buy. High Level Alchemy turns one item plus one nature rune into a fixed number of coins, so it profits whenever that payout beats the item's price plus the rune's, and the current rune price is worked in. Nothing is sold on the Grand Exchange, so no tax applies.
find_alchemy_profit.display_str_template: Find items profitable to high alch.

mock_response.method_note: Profit is the item's High Level Alchemy value less what it costs to buy and less one nature rune at 138 gp. Alching is not a Grand Exchange sale, so no tax applies. Only items trading at least 100 a day, whose price traded in the last 60 minutes, are listed -- so the ones shown can actually be bought at the price shown.

find_flips.description: The items whose buy and sell prices are furthest apart right now, with the 2% tax already taken off and the busiest markets first. Set a budget and only items you could afford come back. Both prices have to have traded within the hour and the item has to trade in real volume, which is what keeps an impossible margin between a fresh price and a three-week-old one out of the list.
find_flips.display_str_template: Find Grand Exchange items worth flipping.

mock_response.method_note: Buy at the sell price, sell at the buy price, and the profit is what is left after the Grand Exchange's 2% cut. Only items whose prices both traded in the last 60 minutes and that trade at least 1,000 a day are listed, because a margin between a fresh price and a three-week-old one cannot be traded at any price.
mock_response.tax_note: The Grand Exchange takes 2% of every sale, rounded down and capped at 5,000,000 gp per item. Some items are exempt. Every profit figure here already has it deducted.

description: Track the Old School RuneScape Grand Exchange and look things up in the game's wiki. Check what an item is worth, price a whole watchlist, chart how a price has moved, see what rose and fell most across the market, find the best flips or the items worth high alching, and search or read any wiki article. Items are chosen by name rather than by id, prices come with how long ago they actually traded, and every profit already has the Grand Exchange's 2% tax taken off. No account or API key is required.
